required_invariants: Project operational master values remain owned by MOD-OPS-001 and are not duplicated into A7 routing records.
A7 may store stable project semantic IDs and project-to-routing-profile relationships.
Each route maps exactly one governed fact class to its A7 authority-owner module.
Route availability never asserts that a project-specific instance, model, schedule, BOQ or drawing already exists.
Module resolution proceeds through registry/entities/modules.json and the module's current A7_MODULE.json pointer.
Research and Study are not default project-execution routes.
Current provider state must be re-read when mutation or freshness matters.
ai_resolution_order: If current operational project-master data is needed, read MOD-OPS-001 projects.csv live.
Select the route matching the requested fact class.
Verify that the selected module is the authority owner in registry/authority/authority-map.json.
Follow the module's current A7_MODULE.json pointer and task-specific routing entrypoint.
Fetch the owning repository/provider live before mutation.
Do not infer project-specific artifact existence from route availability.
